paper_statement: For a smooth zero-sum loss with bounded derivatives through fourth order, Continuous Adam-DA is locally O(h^3)-close to Adam-DA after max{2 log(h)/log|beta|, 2 log(h)/log(rho)} steps on any fixed finite time horizon.

domain.loss: smooth with bounded derivatives through fourth order

machine_check.fixed_horizon: all histories reach exactly t=0.2 before the local comparison
machine_check.burn_in: per-h step count is independently checked to strictly exceed the paper threshold

non_circularity: The eight h values are selected because each divides the independently fixed physical time t=0.2 exactly. The four initial points and acceptance interval are unchanged from the frozen first route. The theorem formula is used only as a post hoc eligibility audit, not to choose a sample count, slope, or tolerance.
